title: The Meridian Penthouse
description: Perched on the 32nd floor, the Meridian Penthouse offers sweeping skyline views through floor-to-ceiling windows. The open-plan living space flows into a chef's kitchen finished in dark stone and brass, while the private terrace is built for evening entertaining. One of the most requested addresses in our downtown portfolio.

title: Oakhaven Villa
description: A family home that balances space with warmth. Oakhaven sits on a quiet tree-lined street with a south-facing garden and pool. Five bedrooms, a dedicated home office, and a kitchen that opens straight onto the patio make it as practical as it is beautiful.

title: Aurelia Court Residence
description: A refined two-bedroom rental in the heart of the city. Aurelia Court combines a calm interior palette with serious convenience - five minutes from the metro, surrounded by cafes, and managed by a responsive building team.

title: Stonebridge Manor
description: Stonebridge Manor is the kind of property that rarely reaches the open market. Set behind private gates, it offers a guest house, a heated pool, and interiors finished by an award-winning local studio. Viewings by appointment only.

title: The Gilded Loft
description: A converted warehouse loft with double-height ceilings and original brickwork. The Gilded Loft suits a tenant who wants character without compromise - industrial bones, modern fittings, and a rooftop shared with just five other residents.

title: Marina Crest Apartment
description: Wake up to the water. Marina Crest offers uninterrupted harbour views from both bedrooms and the main living area. The building's concierge, secure parking, and walk-everywhere location make it a consistent favourite with our buyers.

title: Cedar Row Townhouse
description: A rare four-bedroom townhouse rental arranged over three floors, with a private courtyard at ground level and a roof terrace above. Cedar Row gives a family the space of the suburbs without leaving the city center.

title: Solstice Tower Suite
description: An intelligent first purchase or investment unit in the newest tower downtown. The Solstice Suite is compact but never feels it - full-height glazing, a thought-through layout, and building amenities that rival a hotel.
